name: Addy
source:
Welcome to Nowhere Tech, transfer student- where you'll meet people, make choices, make mistakes, and make even more mistakes. You came here to have new experiences and live a little, but you might get more than you bargained for...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3637820/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
歡迎來到無名理工學院，轉學生！在這裡，你會認識新朋友，作出選擇，犯下錯誤，然後犯下更多錯誤。你來到這裡，是想要些新體驗，趁機好好活一回，可最後的經歷說不定會遠超預期……
